interpretation: Each row is a source and adoption decision, not an end-to-end compatibility claim. A remote protocol boundary does not prove same-process crate compatibility.

repositories.name: librefang
repositories.unresolvedIncompatibility: Its historical same-process SurrealDB 3.2.4 pin is not compatible-by-assumption with UAR 3.3.0; the current convergence checkout also requires refresh before product edits.
repositories.capability: BossFang retains workflow and kernel ownership when delegating a bounded UAR run.

repositories.name: universal-agent-runtime
repositories.unresolvedIncompatibility: Durable team activation is intentionally refused until I2; stale convergence checkout must be refreshed and root/desktop lock inputs reconciled before same-process claims.
repositories.capability: Canonical immutable collaboration definitions, private deployment bindings, UAR execution ownership and SurrealDB 3.3.0 client input.

repositories.name: the-boss
repositories.unresolvedIncompatibility: The retained convergence checkout is stale and must not be used as release evidence; release source, current main and I1 metadata are separate lineages.
repositories.capability: Host-owned product history, principal/admission boundary, sidecar supervision and installed Windows x64/Mac ARM64 UAR operation under release 2.2.3.

repositories.name: flint-gate
repositories.unresolvedIncompatibility: D-GATE is unresolved; action facts, issuer/actor/audience and policy-version mappings must be agreed before adoption. No Cedar crate normalization is inferred.
repositories.capability: Existing Cedar policy and approval boundary remains the governance provider candidate.

repositories.name: flint-realtime-fabric
repositories.unresolvedIncompatibility: D-FRF is unresolved. Its SurrealDB 3.1.5 and Cedar 4.11.1 inputs may interoperate only across a declared service contract until separately proven.
repositories.capability: Transport and delivery remain separate from UAR scheduling and task ownership.

repositories.name: flint-forge
repositories.unresolvedIncompatibility: D-FORGE is unresolved and its Cedar 4.11.2 boundary needs explicit protocol mapping.
repositories.capability: Domain transaction, outbox and row-level-security ownership remain with Forge.

repositories.name: surreal-memory-server
repositories.unresolvedIncompatibility: D-MEMORY still owns authentication, namespace and API compatibility; memory state never becomes runtime task authority.
repositories.capability: Merged I1 source uses the SurrealDB 3.3.0 client and remains a scoped memory provider.

repositories.name: prometheus-skill-pack
repositories.unresolvedIncompatibility: Older surreal-memory and liter-llm gitlinks are provider-propagation work; exact packaged dependencies must be frozen before release.
repositories.capability: Merged I1 agent-team authoring, maintenance, canonical export and UAR deployment adapters.

repositories.name: prometheus-skills-mini

repositories.capability: I1 creator/deployment support and SurrealDB 3.3.0 metadata; accepted shipping closeout is separately anchored at 5f43a25dd027311a8bcbc690eed022031d45aafd.

repositories.name: know-me-app
repositories.unresolvedIncompatibility: D-KNOWME is unresolved; SurrealDB 3.0.5 and the direct inference path cannot be merged into a second execution loop by assumption.
repositories.capability: Product data and direct inference remain product-owned inputs to later embedded/mobile profiles.

repositories.name: know-me-system
repositories.unresolvedIncompatibility: D-KNOWME is unresolved; SurrealDB 3.2.1, liter-llm 1.9.3 and an older vendored UAR require explicit profile compatibility and source refresh.

supportingInputs.name: compass
supportingInputs.acceptedCapability: SurrealDB 3.3.0 and rmcp 3.4.0 support used by the packaged integration.
supportingInputs.unresolvedIncompatibility: Two exact quick-xml advisory exceptions remain temporary and must be removed when SurrealDB permits the patched object-store line.

globalBlocks: Refresh stale or retired convergence worktrees from their recorded default revision before product edits.
Do not mix SurrealDB client crates in one process without a repository-specific proof; use explicit service boundaries otherwise.
Export any SurrealDB 3.2 datastore before first 3.3 access when downgrade recovery is required.
Resolve the actual nine harness/target adapters in C15; historical text saying eight is superseded.
TypeScript 7 remains a pin-or-block requirement for C15 because current pins are lower.
liter-llm adoption must use an exact source revision and capability receipt because historical prose and gitlinks disagree.
